patches.name: Unlock Pro & Disable Rate Dialog
patches.description: Forces the premium check to always return true, unlocking every Pro feature, and stops the in-app "rate us" dialog from ever triggering.

patches.name: Skip/Boost splash screen
patches.description: By default, skips the splash screen entirely on launch. Turn on "Boost splash" to instead keep it briefly on screen (configurable delay) Useless To Boost Splash Screen If You Select Unlock Premium Patch Too Use If You Want To Skip Splash Screen Entirely

options.description: Off: splash is skipped entirely. On: splash briefly shows, then proceeds after the configured delay.
Only used when "Boost splash" is on. How long to show the splash before proceeding.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.

patches.name: Clean main UI
patches.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, keeps the connect/create/join buttons on top, and stops them from being auto-hidden.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation entirely.

patches.name: Speed up splash screen
patches.description: Enters the main activity directly after the splash screen.

patches.name: ES File Explorer Ui Cleanup
patches.description: Removes BookMark, New Files, Cleaner Row In HomePage, Cleans More menu actions

patches.name: Material Colors Upgrade Peach And Purple
patches.description: Updates Accent/Primary/CardBgDark to the newer Material color palette.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Forces the purchase check to always return true, unlocking Pro.

patches.name: Disable From Download Menu Of Browsers
patches.description: Removes only the http/https <data> entries from MiXplorer's Explore/Download/Copy to/Extract to shell activities' VIEW intent filters, so the app stops showing up multiple times in browsers download link chooser.

patches.name: Add Network Stream To Me Tab
patches.description: Repurposes the Video Playlists tile on the Me tab into a Network Stream tile.

patches.name: Clean Me Tab
patches.description: Removes promo rows and unused tiles from the Me tab: WhatsApp Status Saver, Legal/Help, the local-tiles pager, Local Network, Music Player, Cloud Drive, MX Share, and Private Folder.

patches.name: Disable Bottom Bar And Add Me Tab To Top
patches.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar and adds a Me tab button to the toolbar.

patches.name: Hide File Transfer, Video Playlist, Private Folder tiles
patches.description: Removes the File Transfer, Video Playlist, and Private Folder tiles from settings Page.

patches.name: Hide Settings Page UseLess Buttons
patches.description: Collapses the WhatsApp, Legal, and Help entries on the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide top tiles
patches.description: Hides the top tiles.

patches.name: Skip Splash Screen
patches.description: Skips Splash Screen so the app boots straight past the splash and update screen.

patches.name: Clean sidebar
patches.description: Hides the Bookmarks, remote-connection and Category sections from the navigation sidebar, and hides Encrypt and Downloader from the Storage section.

patches.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches.name: Disable rate us dialog
patches.description: Overrides show() on the in-app "rate us" dialog so it's still built but never displayed.

patches.name: Hide more actions
patches.description: Hides Hide, Add to desktop, Encrypt, Decrypt, Add bookmark, Web Search, Copy to, Move to, Transfer, and Playing from the "More actions" menu.

patches.name: Hide network, tools and bookmarks on home page
patches.description: Hides the Network, Tools and Bookmarks sections from the home page section list.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Skips Splash Screen From 2nd App Opening

patches.name: Clean SnapTube Settings Page
patches.description: Removes the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches.name: Disable Annoying Snaptube Notifications
patches.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches.name: Remove from default browser list
patches.description: Strips the LinkHandleActivity alias's unscoped so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.

patches.name: Remove Watch Ad To Download
patches.description: Removes the requirement to watch a rewarded ad before a download starts.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Forces the Pro flag true at every read and write site in the dex, unlocking Pro.

patches.name: Remove License Verification
patches.description: Spoofs every PackageManager.getInstallerPackageName() check to report "com.android.vending", so Pro features unlock regardless of install source.

patches.name: Change Cleaner & Media Tab Defaults
patches.description: Changes first-run defaults: hides the Image, Video, Audio and Cleaner tabs, and shows hidden files by default. Only affects users who have never changed the setting themselves - the preference override still takes priority.

patches.name: Disable Rate Us Dialog
patches.description: Prevents the in-app rate-us dialog from ever being shown.

patches.name: Unlock Pro & Skip Splash Screen
patches.description: Forces the ad-removed/Pro check to always return true, and renames the launcher activity from SplashActivity to MainActivity so the splash screen is skipped.

patches.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches.description: Removes the http/https <data> entries from BrowserDownloaderActivity's so the app stops offering itself in the system "Download file with" chooser for ordinary web downloads.

patches.name: Remove from default browser list
patches.description: Removes http/https <data> entries from MainTabsActivity's so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Skips splash screen so the app opens directly to the main screen.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Only Use In V2.7.2. Signature verification is spoofed automatically so the purchase check passes without manually applying Spoof app signature.

patches.name: Disable ad dialog when reopening app
patches.description: Prevents the full-screen "loading ad" dialog from appearing when the app is reopened after being minimized.

patches.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches.description: Strips WebDownloadActivity's intent-filter data so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches.name: Remove from default browser list
patches.description: Removes the unscoped http/https <data> entries from MainActivity's first intent-filter carrying them so the app stops appearing as a candidate in the system's default browser / "open with" chooser.

patches.name: Skip splash and language screens
patches.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation, the language-selection screen, and any ad/app-open dialog normally shown first.
